# area: gradual_any
# hypothesis: An Any value passed through an int parameter and cast to int stays a str at runtime, so assert_type accepts int while describe reports str.
from typing import Any, assert_type, cast, reveal_type


def as_int(n: int) -> int:
    return n


def describe(o: object) -> str:
    return type(o).__name__


raw: Any = 'text'
passed = as_int(raw)
assert_type(passed, int)
forced = cast(int, raw)
assert_type(forced, int)
reveal_type(forced)
assert describe(forced) == 'str'
assert describe(passed) == 'str'
obj: object = raw
print(describe(obj))
print(forced.upper())  # expect-error
hypothesis: An Any value passed through an int parameter and cast to int stays a str at runtime, so assert_type accepts int while the runtime type is str.
